name: shaughv-code
description: Emmett Shaughnessy's personal Codex skills bundle. Provides SHAUGHV skills for critical thinking (seven agent-first thinking frameworks incl. strategic/adversarial reasoning via Art of War, 36 Stratagems, Five Rings, and game theory), OpenAI audio, PreText, Quiver AI, a comprehensive Mistral AI API skill (OCR, audio transcription, text-to-speech, chat, agents, and the full API surface), brand design, animated brandmark, human changelog, CDN usage, naming conventions, Google Cloud Storage, bug triage, code design patterns, debugging, defensive programming, git workflow, a security audit & red-team skill, a session handoff document generator, an iterative milestone-planning method, a workflow-optimization facilitator, image generation, a fal.ai Crystal image upscaler, deliberate learning, logical reasoning, personal productivity, the wb300 git branch / worktree / agent control tower, a usage status-line installer, and the TT;DR "Too Tired; Didn't Read" summary convention. (The Claude-only subagent model/effort preference skill is intentionally omitted from the Codex surface. The task + workplace-memory system now lives in the standalone shaughv-tasks plugin.)

interface.longDescription: Use Emmett Shaughnessy's personal skills in Codex for SHAUGHV brand work, OpenAI audio, Quiver AI vector generation, naming conventions, human changelogs, CDN usage, and Google Cloud Storage workflows. The Codex surface bundles the same MCP servers as the Claude surface (Remotion documentation and Craft Docs); the /create-video slash command remains Claude-only. Codex installs from a tracked, self-contained package under plugins/shaughv-code/, regenerated from repo root by build-codex-plugin.ps1.
defaultPrompt: Use shaughv-design to build a SHAUGHV-branded page.
Use openai-audio to plan a Realtime voice agent.
